routes.name: Stay and work of EEA nationals

note: Croatia, read on the Ministry of the Interior's own pages on 2026-10-30. Temporary stay for the purpose of work is granted as a stay and work permit, for one job and one employer (read as work for the sponsor), mostly on the Croatian Employment Service's labour market test; temporary stay is granted for up to one year and extended (renewal for the same employer and worker needs no new test); it is applied for at a Croatian diplomatic mission or consular post abroad or, by one who needs no visa to enter, also at a police administration in Croatia (either). The fee kept is the 46.45 euros for being granted temporary stay at a police administration; the biometric residence permit costs 31.85 euros more (59.73 accelerated) and 9.29 euros for its issue, which the form doesn't hold, and the page for highly-qualified workers sets 74.32 euros for an EU Blue Card's stay and work permit. Long-term residence follows five years' uninterrupted lawful stay, temporary stay included (5 kept); its fee isn't on the page. EEA nationals and their families work and provide services without a stay and work permit, registering their temporary stay. No decision time is published, and naturalisation's years weren't read, so no route is marked as counting.

sources.title: Ministry of the Interior (Croatia), Temporary stay of third-country nationals
sources.said: Temporary stay for the purpose of work is granted as a stay and work permit. ... An application for temporary stay is submitted at a diplomatic mission or consular post of the Republic of Croatia. ... Temporary stay is granted for a period of up to one year. ... aliens have to pay the amount of 46,45 EUR to be granted temporary stay and 31,85 EUR for the production of a biometric residence permit (59,73 EUR for accelerated procedure) ... Third-country nationals who are not required to have a visa to enter the Republic of Croatia may also apply for temporary stay at a police administration/police station according to their intended place of stay, their employer’s head office or their place of work.

sources.title: Ministry of the Interior (Croatia), Work of third-country nationals
sources.said: Third-country nationals may work in the Republic of Croatia only on those jobs for which they have been granted a stay and work permit or a work registration certificate and only with those employers with which they have entered into employment. ... in case the validity of a stay and work permit is extended for the same employer and the same third-country national

sources.title: Ministry of the Interior (Croatia), Long-term residence and permanent stay
sources.said: Long-term residence may be granted to third-country nationals who have been legally staying in the Republic of Croatia for an uninterrupted period of five years before submitting their application , which includes temporary stay

sources.title: Ministry of the Interior (Croatia), Stay and work of EEA nationals and their family members
sources.said: EEA nationals and their family members may work and provide services in the Republic of Croatia without a stay and work permit, or a work registration certificate.
